data.long_meaning: Azriella is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew words 'Azar' (help) and 'El' (God). This name is a feminine variant of the masculine name Azriel, which means 'God is my help'. In the Bible, there is a character named Azriel, who is a priest and a gatekeeper of the temple in Jerusalem. The name Azriella signifies a helper or aid given by God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes divine assistance and support.
data.etymology: Azriella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azriella total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אזרילה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אזרילה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים עוזר ומשגיח עלי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אזרי' שפירושו 'עזר' ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם אזרילה מבטא את הרעיון של אלוהים כעזר וכמשגיח על האדם. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד.

in_greek.name: Αζριέλλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αζριέλλα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός βοηθά και φυλάσσει'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'Αζρι' που σημαίνει 'βοήθεια' και 'Ελλά' που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το όνομα Αζριέλλα εκφράζει την ιδέα του Θεού ως βοηθού και φύλακα του ανθρώπου. Το όνομα απαντάται στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας και στις κοινότητες των πιστών.

in_latin.name: Azriella
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Azriella originem habet in lingua hebraica et significat 'Deus adiuvat et custodit'. Nomen constat ex duabus vocibus: 'Azri' quod significat 'adiutorium' et 'ella' quod significat 'Deus'. Nomen Azriella exprimit ideam Dei adiutoris et custodis hominis. Nomen in usu est apud communitates christianas et judaicas.

in_english.name: Azriella
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azriella originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the words 'azri' meaning 'help' and 'El' or 'ella' meaning 'God'. The name conveys the idea of God as a helper and watcher over the individual. Azriella is used in both Jewish and Christian traditions, symbolizing divine assistance and providence. The name reflects a deep spiritual meaning, emphasizing the protective and supportive role of God in one's life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azriella holds great significance in Hebrew culture, as it is derived from ancient Hebrew roots. This name is a symbol of divine help and support, reminiscent of the strength and guidance provided by God in the Old Testament.
data.spiritual_significance: Azriella is a deeply spiritual name, representing the idea of faith and trust in God's protection and guidance. It is a reminder of the promise that God is always by our side, ready to provide aid and support when we needed it most. This name holds special significance for those who value their faith and believe in the power of divine intervention.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Azriella: God's helper in the vineyard of grace. A name evoking the spirit of devotion and service in the divine garden of God's love.

historical_references.reference: Azriella was a Jewish martyr during the Roman persecution of Christians under Emperor Trajan around 112 AD. Her name appears in various early Christian martyrologies as a saint and has been adopted by some Christian communities as a name for girls.

Azriella is also mentioned in the 12th century Latin hagiography 'The Golden Legend' as a Jewish girl who converted to Christianity and was martyred during the reign of Emperor Hadrian around 130 AD. The story is likely a later invention and has been criticized for promoting anti-Semitic sentiments.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Azriella continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Grace Azriella in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Azriella, which means "God's helper". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
